items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: You only write the logical, you know? You don't try to prove that you are Bach or Beethoven.

ctx.x: I've been very lucky in that I haven't -- oh, I know

a lot of things that I've done that I haven't liked that I could have done better. Oh, for one reason or the other. Sometimes it's my fault, sometimes it's the fault of circumstances or last minute panics. Not having time to really, you know, prepare yourself. And then there are other times that last minute panics you do better because you don't have any time to try to prove anything. You only write the logical, you know? You don't try to prove that you are Bach or Beethoven.
